tools.description: List the secrets you may use: refs, kinds, sensitivity, destinations and approval requirements. Never values.
tools.name: list

tools.description: Show one secret's operations, with their parameters, and the jobs you may run with it.
tools.name: describe

tools.description: Make a brokered call with a secret: a named operation, or an open request where the grant allows one. Read the structured state independently of HTTP success. If awaiting_approval, check status using request_ref; after approved with next:resubmit, explicitly re-submit the identical request_id and body. Status never dispatches.

data.description: An open request's body: a string, or a JSON object.

headers.description: Ordered 'Name: value' strings. Named operations allow only their declared header names; fixed and injected headers cannot be overridden.

reason.description: Shown to the approver as untrusted text.

request_id.description: Supply this ID once and reuse it with the identical body for retries and after approval. It is never generated by the tool.

tools.name: request

tools.description: Run a pinned job on a runner, with the credentials its definition names. Supply request_id. Check aggregate status using request_ref: one approved slot does not approve the run. After approved with next:resubmit, explicitly re-submit the identical ID and body. Admitted means waiting for the runner, not completed. The agent never receives credentials.

reason.description: Shown to the approver as untrusted text.

request_id.description: Supply this ID once and reuse it with the identical body for retries and after approval. It is never generated by the tool.

runner.description: The runner to run the job on.

secret.description: An ordinary derived child's ref for the unique durable slot; omit to use the job's fixed selectors.

tools.name: run

tools.description: Show request, approval or reconciliation state by request_id or a returned locator. Use request_ref for aggregate run approval status. Never a link, admission or dispatch. If approved with next:resubmit, explicitly re-submit the original request with the same request_id and unchanged body. Read state even when HTTP succeeds.
tools.name: status

tools.description: Cancel your own request while it is not yet admitted.
tools.name: cancel

tools.description: Narrow authority at once: revoke a grant, approvals or an approver's passkey or contact, disable a secret or the installation, or deregister a runner. Owners; assigned approvers may revoke their own approvals.

credential_id.description: For revoke-approver, the lost passkey credential ID as unpadded base64url. Omit to revoke the contact and full designation.

request_id.description: Supply this ID once and reuse it with the identical body for retries and after approval. It is never generated by the tool.

target.description: The grant, approval, secret, runner or approver id.

tools.name: contain

tools.description: Draft a widening metadata or authority change. It takes effect only after an owner's passkey confirmation on the console. Never accepts a secret value.

request_id.description: Supply this ID once and reuse it with the identical body for retries and after approval. It is never generated by the tool.

tools.name: propose-change

tools.description: Show the owner's operational record of requests, approvals and dispatches, including outcomes that need reconciliation. Never values.
tools.name: activity
